testimonials.title: Itsandvwa nguMabandla
testimonials.subtitle: Joyina emabandla lakhulako lasagucule inkonzo yawo ngenkundla yetfu yamahhala ngalokuphelele. Naku lokushiwo bafundisi nebaphatsi bemabandla nge-B1.

items.content: Ngincoma i-ChurchApps ngenhlitiyo yonkhe. Iyinkonzo ngendlela leyiyo nalencono yalelo gama. I-ChurchApps iniketa tinsita tebuchwepheshe kute kutfutfukiswe futsi kuphakanyiswe umtselela wakamoya wemabandla emiphakatsini yawo. Batawusita sisekelo seliBandla iminyaka letako.
I-ChurchApps isisitile kutsi sibonakale kakhudlwana emphakatsini wetfu—yenyusa kwatiwa, iminikelo, nemavolontiya kute sikwati kusita kancono imindeni lesweleko.

I-ChurchApps ingetulu kwe-software—ilithulusi lelisebentako lelisekela umgomo, umbono, nemsebenti wemihla ngemihla wenkonzo. Ngiyabonga litfuba lekuyifundza, kuyifundzisa, nekubona indlela lenika ngayo emabandla emandla ekusebenta ngekucondza, kusebenta kahle, nenhloso lenkhulu.

Kuba nelikhasi leminikelo kwenyuse kupha enhlanganweni yetfu. Bantfu abajabuleli nje kuphela kulula kwekuskena likhodi lelibayisa ngco ekhasini leminikelo, kupha kwanyanga tonkhe kungahlelwa kulabo labafuna kutsi kupha nge-inthanethi kube lula.

Ngitsandza kugcina emarekhodi ekubakhona, futsi sisebentisa i-B1 Admin onkhe emaSontfo ngaleyo nhloso. Siyayibonga kakhulu insita ye-B1 Admin, lekhombise kuba yindlela lesebentako yelibandla letfu yekugcina emarekhodi ebantfu nekubakhona.

testimonials.ctaDescription: Joyina umphakatsi lokhulako wemabandla lasasebentisa i-B1 - mahhala ngalokuphelele phakadze. Kute likhadi lesikweletu lelidzingekako, kute kuzama, kute timali letifihlakele.

faq.documentTitle: Imibuto Levamile - B1.church | Imibuto Nge-Software Yekuphatsa Libandla Yamahhala

items.question: Ingabe i-B1.church imahhala ngempela nge-100%?
items.answer: Yebo, i-B1.church imahhala ngalokuphelele kute timali letifihlakele, kute emazinga laphakeme lakhokhelwako, futsi kute timali tekutsengiselana kuminikelo. Siyinkonzo lengakenteli inzuzo ye-501(c)(3) lekholwa kutsi lonkhe libandla lifanelwe kufinyelela kubuchwepheshe besimanje ngale kwesabelotimali. Inkundla yetfu ixhaswa yiminikelo nema-Google Ad Grants.

items.question: I-B1.church ifaka tiphi timphawu?
items.answer: I-B1.church ifaka inkundla yekuphatsa libandla lephelele: i-app yemakhalekhukhwini yemalunga lefakwa ngco kusuka kuliwebhusayithi lakho, sakhi seliwebhusayithi sekuhudvula-ulahle, kupha nge-inthanethi ngaphandle kwetimali tenkundla letengetiwe, luhlelo lwe-check-in lwebantfwana ngemakhodi ekuphepha, kudathabhesi yemalunga, kulandzelela kubakhona, kuphatfwa kwemacembu, kuhlela tinkonzo, umtapo wetingoma, kuphatfwa kwetintjumayelo, nekuhlanganiswa kweliBhayibheli.

items.question: I-B1.church icatsaniswa njani ne-Planning Center?
items.answer: I-B1.church imahhala nge-100% kantsi i-Planning Center ikhokhelwa ngemojula ($0-299+/ngenyanga). I-B1 ifaka i-app yemakhalekhukhwini nesakhi seliwebhusayithi ngaphandle kwenkhokhelo, kantsi i-Planning Center ikhokhelisa ngekwengetiwe nge-Church Center futsi ayifaki sakhi seliwebhusayithi. Totimbili tiniketa timphawu tekuphatsa libandla, kodvwa i-B1 iniketa konkhe kuliphakheji linye lelimahhala.

items.question: I-B1.church icatsaniswa njani ne-Pushpay?
items.answer: I-B1.church imahhala ngalokuphelele kantsi i-Pushpay ibita $300-1000+/ngenyanga. I-B1 ite timali tekutsengiselana ekupheni, kantsi i-Pushpay itsatsa liphesenti leminikelo. I-B1 ingumtfombo lovulekile futsi ifaka kuphatfwa kwelibandla lokuphelele, kantsi i-Pushpay iyimfihlo futsi igcile kakhulu ekupheni.

items.question: I-B1.church icatsaniswa njani ne-Tithe.ly?
items.answer: I-B1.church imahhala ngalokuphelele kute timali tekutsengiselana. I-Tithe.ly iniketa lizinga lelimahhala kodvwa ikhokhelisa ngetimphawu letiphakeme futsi itsatsa liphesenti kuwo wonkhe umnikelo. I-B1 ifaka i-software yekuphatsa libandla lephelele, kantsi i-ChMS ye-Tithe.ly ingumkhicito lokhokhelwako lohlukile.

items.question: I-B1.church icatsaniswa njani ne-Breeze ChMS?
items.answer: I-B1.church imahhala kantsi i-Breeze icala ku-$72/ngenyanga. I-B1 ifaka i-app yemakhalekhukhwini lephelele nesakhi seliwebhusayithi, kantsi i-Breeze inetimphawu temakhalekhukhwini letincane futsi ite sakhi seliwebhusayithi. Totimbili tiniketa kuphatfwa kwelibandla, kodvwa i-B1 iniketa timphawu letinyenti ngaphandle kwenkhokhelo.

items.question: Ingabe libandla lami litfola i-app yemakhalekhukhwini?
items.answer: Yebo. I-B1 inika libandla lakho i-app yemakhalekhukhwini lenelibrendi lakho njenge-web app lefakekako (PWA). Emalunga avula sayithi yelibandla lakho, acindzetele 'Add to Home Screen', bese atfola i-app yesikrini lesigcwele leneligama nelilogo lelibandla lakho. Tibuyeketo tifika kubo bonkhe masinyane.

items.question: Ingabe i-B1.church isekela kupha nge-inthanethi?
items.answer: Yebo, i-B1.church ifaka kupha nge-inthanethi lokuphephile ngekusekelwa kwelikhadi lesikweletu nekutfumela ngelibhange. Ungahlela iminikelo lephindzaphindzekako, uphatse timali letinyenti, futsi unikete umlandvo wekupha wetitatimende tentela. Sisebentisa kuhlanganiswa kwe-Stripe ngco ngaphandle kwetimali tenkundla ye-B1 - libandla lakho lixoxisana ngemanani ngco ne-Stripe (ngokuvamile cishe 2.9% + 30¢).

items.question: Ngingakha liwebhusayithi nge-B1.church?
items.answer: Yebo, i-B1.church ifaka sakhi seliwebhusayithi sekuhudvula-ulahle nemathempulethi lavumelana nemakhalekhukhwini. Ungasebentisa idomeyini yakho, futsi liwebhusayithi lihlangana nato tonkhe timphawu takho te-B1 njengemicimbi, emacembu, nekupha.

items.question: Ingabe i-B1.church ine-check-in yenkonzo yebantfwana?
items.answer: Yebo, i-B1.church ifaka luhlelo lwe-check-in loluhlakaniphile ngemakhiyoski ekutisita langatsintvwa, ku-check-in kwemndeni, kunikwa kwemacembu ngekutentakalela, emakhodi ekuphepha ekulandvweni kwebantfwana, nekulandzelela kubakhona ngemibiko.

items.question: Ingabe i-B1.church ingumtfombo lovulekile?
items.answer: Yebo, i-B1.church ingumtfombo lovulekile ngalokugcwele. Ungabuka ikhodi yetfu ku-GitHub ku-github.com/ChurchApps. Loku kusho kutsi ungati-hosta wena nangabe ufuna, ufake sandla ekutfutfukiseni, futsi wetsembe kutsi idatha yakho iphatfwa ngekukhanya.

items.question: Ngubani lowakha i-B1.church?
items.answer: I-B1.church yakhiwa yi-Live Church Solutions, inhlangano lengakenteli inzuzo ye-501(c)(3) (EIN 45-5349618). Siyinkonzo yebathfutfukisi labakholwa kutsi emabandla akufanele akhetse emkhatsini webuchwepheshe nekuxhaswa kwenkonzo.

items.question: Ngumiphi leminye imikhicito yamahhala leniketwa yi-Live Church Solutions?
items.answer: Ngetulu kwe-B1.church, siniketa i-FreeShow (i-software yemboniso yamahhala ku-freeshow.app, lokunye esikhundleni se-ProPresenter) ne-Lessons.church (ikharikhulamu yelibandla yamahhala lenetifundvo letingetulu kwa-1,100 tabo bonkhe iminyaka). Yonkhe imikhicito yetfu imahhala futsi ingumtfombo lovulekile.

items.question: Ngicala njani nge-B1.church?
items.answer: Kucala kulula: vakashela b1.church, ucindzetele 'Cala Mahhala', wakhe i-akhawunti yelibandla lakho, ulungise i-app neliwebhusayithi lakho, bese umema libandla lakho. Kute likhadi lesikweletu lelidzingekako futsi kute sikhatsi sekuzama - kumahhala phakadze.

items.question: Ingabe i-B1.church isekela emakhampasi lamanyenti?
items.answer: Yebo, i-B1.church isekela emabandla lanemakhampasi lamanyenti. Ungaphatsa tindzawo letinyenti kusuka kudheshbhodi yinye lehlanganisiwe ngedatha, kubakhona, nemacembu lakhetsekile ngelikhampasi kube ugcina kudathabhesi yemalunga yinye.

planning-center.name: Planning Center

pushpay.description: I-Pushpay yatiwa ngekupha ngemakhalekhukhwini kodvwa ita netindleko tanyanga tonkhe letinkhulu netimali tekutsengiselana. I-B1.church iniketa kupha ngetimali tenkundla letingu-ziro.
pushpay.verdict: I-Pushpay inetimphawu letinyenti kodvwa iyabita. I-B1.church iniketa timphawu tekupha letifanako kanye nekuphatfwa kwelibandla lokuphelele ngaphandle kwenkhokhelo. Kongiwa kungabuyiselwa enkonzweni.

tithely.name: Tithe.ly
tithely.description: I-Tithe.ly iniketa emathulusi ekupha nekuphatsa libandla ngemanani e-freemium. I-B1.church iniketa konkhe mahhala ngaphandle kwetimali tekutsengiselana.
tithely.verdict: Lizinga lelimahhala le-Tithe.ly linemkhawulo. Kute utfole kusebenta lokuphelele, tindleko tikhula masinyane. I-B1.church ifaka konkhe kusukela ngelusuku lwekucala ngaphandle kwekucindzetelwa kutsi ukhuphule.

breeze.name: Breeze ChMS
breeze.description: I-Breeze luhlelo lwekuphatsa libandla lolulula lolunemanani lacacile. I-B1.church iniketa timphawu letinyenti ngaphandle kwenkhokhelo.
breeze.verdict: I-Breeze ilula futsi iyafinyeleleka, kodvwa i-B1.church ilula kakhudlwana kusabelotimali (mahhala!) kube iniketa timphawu letinyenti njengesakhi seliwebhusayithi ne-app yemakhalekhukhwini lephelele.

hero.title: I-Software Yekuphatsa Libandla
hero.description: I-software yekuphatsa libandla yelizinga lelisebenti nekulandzelela kubakhona, kudathabhesi yemalunga, kuphatfwa kwekupha, nemathulusi ekuchumana. I-software yelibandla yamahhala ngalokuphelele leniketwa yi-Live Church Solutions, inkonzo lengakenteli inzuzo ye-501(c)(3). Joyina emabandla langetulu kwa-100 longa tinkhulungwane etindlekweni te-software yenkonzo.

featuresHeader.title: Timphawu
featuresHeader.description: I-software yekudathabhesi yelibandla yelizinga lelisebenti nekuphatfwa kwemalunga, kulandzelela kubakhona, kuphatfwa kwekupha, nemathulusi ekuchumana kwenkonzo. Luhlelo lwekuphatsa libandla lwamahhala lolwakhelwe ngco emabandla lakhulako nemabandla lanemakhampasi lamanyenti.

checkinStations.title: Titeshi Te-Check-in Tekutisita
checkinStations.description: Cinisekisa kuphepha kwebantfwana kube ukhulula emavolontiya kutsi asebente nemindeni. Luhlelo lwetfu lwe-check-in lwekutisita lukhipha emakhodi lacondzanako ebantfwana nebadzala, lokwenta inchubo yekulandvwa lephephile.
features: Sesha ngenombolo yelucingo bese ukhetsa tinkonzo ngekutentakalela
Iphrinta emalebula nemarisidi ngaphandle kwetintsambo kumaphrinta labelwane

mainFeatures.title: Kuphatfwa Kwebantfu Lokuphelele
mainFeatures.description: Gcina emarekhodi emalunga netivakashi lanemininingwane ngelwati lwekutsintsana, budlelwane, emalanga ekutalwa, nekulandzelela emaminyaka emshado. Emandla ekusesha nekuhlunga lasezingeni leliphakeme.

mainFeatures.title: Kuhlatiywa Kwekubakhona
mainFeatures.description: Landzelela emathrendi ekubakhona kuto tonkhe tinkonzo nemacembu ngemashadi nemibiko lemihle. Bukisisa emaphethini ekutimbandzakanya nekukhula ngesikhatsi.

mainFeatures.title: Kuphatfwa Kwemacembu & Tinkonzo
mainFeatures.description: Hlela emacembu, emaklasi, netinkonzo letingenamkhawulo. Phatsa kunikwa kwemalunga, ulandzelele kuhlanganyela, wakhe imikhakha yemacembu yangekhetselwe.

mainFeatures.title: Kuphatfwa Kwekupha Lokusezingeni Leliphakeme
mainFeatures.description: Sebenta iminikelo ngekuphatfwa kwemabhetji, kulandzelela timali, nekubika kwetetimali lokuphelele. Khipha titatimende tentela ubukisise emathrendi ekupha.

mainFeatures.title: Kuhlela Kwekukhonta & Inkonzo
mainFeatures.description: Hlela tinkonzo tekukhonta, unike emalunga elicembu, uphatse kuhlanganiswa kwemavolontiya. Landzelela tikhundla letidzingekako wente tatiso titentakalele.

mainFeatures.title: Umtapo Wetingoma & Emahlelo
mainFeatures.description: Hlela umtapo wakho wetingoma lophelele ngemahlelo lamanyenti, emakhiye, nemashadi emakhodi. Xhumanisa netinsita tangaphandle uphatse ema-setlist ekukhonta.

mainFeatures.title: Sikhungo Sekuchumana
mainFeatures.description: Tfumela ema-imeyili netimemetelo leticondzisiwe. Yakha tinchubo letitentakalelako ugcine libandla lakho lihlangene.

mainFeatures.title: Kusekelwa Kwemakhampasi Lamanyenti
mainFeatures.description: Phatsa tindzawo letinyenti kusuka kudheshbhodi yinye lehlanganisiwe. Landzelela idatha yelikhampasi ngalinye kube ugcina kubika kwenhlangano yonkhe.

testimonials.title: Itsandvwa nguMabandla
testimonials.subtitle: Joyina emabandla lakhulako lasagucule inkonzo yawo ngenkundla yetfu yamahhala ngalokuphelele. Naku lokushiwo bafundisi nebaphatsi bemabandla.

items.content: Sisebentisa lenkundla onkhe emaSontfo kulandzelela kubakhona nekugcina emarekhodi abo bonkhe labafikako, kufaka ekhatsi bantfwana betfu besikolwa seliSontfo. Njengetitfunywa letinesabelotimali lesincane, siyakubonga kutsi le-software imahhala futsi iyasebenta.

Lona ngumsindzisi welibandla. Njengelibandla lelincane lelinesabelotimali lesincane, le-software ITFUNYELWE NGUNKULUNKULU futsi iyisibusiso. Ilula kumsebentisi futsi kulula kuyihlela. Imibiko yeminikelo kulula kuyibhala. Kutsi ngingakhipha idatha ku-excel kwenta kuhlatiywa kwemarekhodi kube lula kakhulu. Ingephulile lokungenani 25% wesikhatsi sami sehhovisi.

Loku kwasisita kutsi sendlulele ekupheni kwedijithali kalula ngesikhatsi selubhubhane. Licembu lelusito belimangalisa futsi inkundla yetsembeke kakhulu. Kuba mahhala kwasivumela kutsi sibuyisele sabelotimali setfu se-software enkonzweni yangempela.

aboutSection.title: Mayelana Ne-Software
aboutSection.description: I-software yekuphatsa libandla lephelele leniketwa mahhala ngalokuphelele emabandleni emaKrestu netinkonzo yi-Live Church Solutions, inhlangano lengakenteli inzuzo ye-501(c)(3) leyasungulwa nga-2012. Umgomo wetfu kusita emabandla kutsi asebentise i-software yenkonzo yelizinga lelisebenti ngaphandle kwetindleko letiphakeme letivamile tetinhlelo tekuphatsa libandla.

mission.title: Umgomo Wetfu: Kusita Emabandla Kutsi Agcile Enkonzweni
